tools.name: get_cart_status
tools.description: Retrieves current shopping cart state, total item count, and checkout readiness for The Vault.

tools.name: get_product_details
tools.description: Retrieves comprehensive product specifications, genetics, breeder information, pricing, and stock status for a given cannabis seed strain.

product_id_or_url.description: Product URL slug, path, or SKU (e.g., "/barneys-farm-gorilla-glue-auto", "barneys-farm-gorilla-glue-auto", or SKU identifier)

tools.name: get_seed_categories
tools.description: Lists main cannabis seed categories, breeder collections, and popular classifications available at The Vault.

tools.name: inspect_image_c2pa
tools.description: Fetch a single image (by CSS selector or URL) and return its fully decoded C2PA manifest store: every manifest's claim, assertions (e.g. c2pa.actions edit history, schema.org authorship), and the COSE signature details (algorithm and signing-certificate identity). Provide exactly one of `selector` or `url`. Note: the signature is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

selector.description: CSS selector for an element on the page.

url.description: Image URL (absolute, or relative to the current page) to fetch and inspect.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigates the user or browser agent to a designated destination or section of The Vault website.

destination.description: Target section on The Vault store

tools.name: scan_images_c2pa
tools.description: Scan every on the current page for C2PA Content Credentials (content provenance metadata) and return a per-image summary: whether a manifest is present, the claim generator (the tool that produced or edited the image), the title, and the signer name. Use this to find which images on a page carry provenance data. Note: provenance is decoded but NOT cryptographically verified.

limit.description: Maximum number of images to fetch and scan (default 25, max 100).

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Searches The Vault cannabis seeds catalog by keyword, strain name, category, or breeder with optional result limits.

query.description: Search query or strain name (e.g., "Gorilla Glue", "Northern Lights", "Barneys Farm", "Gelato", "Autoflowering")

limit.description: Maximum number of product results to return (default: 10, max: 50)
